description: Defines a base class for fragments in an Android application, providing common functionality such as toolbar setup, transitions, and activity result handling.

classes.name: BaseFragment
classes.description: A base class for fragments that provides common setup for toolbars, transitions, and interaction with activity results.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up transition animations if default animations are enabled.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Called after the view is created; sets up the toolbar.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the support action bar and its title.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to other fragments via fragment result API.
